title: mermaid-mcp
description: MCP server for Mermaid diagram validation and rendering
summary: MCP server for Mermaid diagram validation and rendering
offersHint: MCP server for Mermaid diagram validation and rendering · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.mermaidchart.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: validate_and_render_mermaid_diagram
toolsPreview.description: SIMPLE RENDER TOOL - Renders Mermaid diagrams directly (Mermaid automatically validates during rendering). If successful, returns diagram image. If Mermaid validation fails, returns error details for fixing. One tool, one call, simple workflow.

toolsPreview.name: get_diagram_title
toolsPreview.description: Generate a descriptive title for a Mermaid diagram based on its content. This tool analyzes the diagram structure and content to suggest an appropriate title.

toolsPreview.name: get_diagram_summary
toolsPreview.description: Generate a concise summary for a Mermaid diagram based on its content. This tool provides prompts for the LLM to generate a brief summary (2-4 sentences) highlighting the primary flow, key decisions, and outcomes.

toolsPreview.name: search_mermaid_icons
toolsPreview.description: Search for available Mermaid icons by provider or name. Returns icons in ready-to-use format with provider prefixes (e.g., 'aws:arch-amazon-ec2'). PERFORMANCE TIP: For faster searches, start with limit=10 and specific queries. If no suitable icons found, increase limit and retry. Supports AWS, Azure, GCP, and FontAwesome icon sets.

toolsPreview.name: get_mermaid_syntax_document
toolsPreview.description: Get comprehensive syntax documentation and examples for a specific Mermaid diagram type. Returns the official Mermaid.js documentation with syntax rules, examples, and usage instructions for the requested diagram type.

toolsPreview.name: list_tools
toolsPreview.description: Lists all available MCP servers and their tools in the workspace.

toolsPreview.name: list_repos
toolsPreview.description: List GitHub repositories for the authenticated user, or for an organization when `org` is set. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` header (HTTP) or `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` in the server environment.

toolsPreview.name: list_mermaid_files
toolsPreview.description: List .mmd Mermaid files in a GitHub repository (code search with tree fallback). REQUIRES: `Github-Token` header (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: read_mermaid_file
toolsPreview.description: Read a single .mmd file from a GitHub repository. Only paths ending in .mmd are allowed. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` header (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: create_pr
toolsPreview.description: Create a new branch (git ref), one commit from the base tree with your file changes, then open a pull request in the same repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN with `contents: write` (and no existing branch with the same `headBranch` name).

toolsPreview.name: push_file
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a single file on a given branch in a GitHub repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN with contents write access.

toolsPreview.name: list_pulls
toolsPreview.description: List pull requests for a GitHub repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: list_branches
toolsPreview.description: List or resolve branch names. **List mode (default):** one `GET /repos/.../branches?per_page=100&page=1` — at most 100 names, A–Z sorted in the response; `has_more` if a full page was returned. **Resolve mode:** set `branch_name` for a single `GET` branch (404 if missing). At most one GitHub API call. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: list_issues
toolsPreview.description: List issues for a repository (excludes pull requests). REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: create_issue
toolsPreview.description: Create an issue in a GitHub repository. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN with issues write if creating issues in private repos.

toolsPreview.name: get_issue_comments
toolsPreview.description: List comments on an issue by issue number. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: get_pull_comments
toolsPreview.description: Get all pull request comments: both issue/PR thread comments and inline review comments, with a `type` of `issue_thread` or `review` per item. REQUIRES: `Github-Token` (HTTP) or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.

toolsPreview.name: generate_ticket_dependency_tree
toolsPreview.description: Generate a Mermaid flowchart that visualises Jira issue dependency links for a project. Each node shows the ticket key, summary, and status, and is a clickable link to the ticket. Dashed nodes represent issues linked from outside the current filter set.

toolsPreview.name: generate_jira_kanban_board
toolsPreview.description: Generate a Mermaid kanban board from Jira issues. Issues are grouped into columns by their current status and ordered by workflow stage (To Do → In Progress → Done). Each card shows the issue summary and is a clickable link to the ticket, with optional assignee and priority badges.

toolsPreview.name: generate_ticket_diagram
toolsPreview.description: Generate a Mermaid flowchart centred on a single Jira ticket. Fetches the ticket's subtasks, parent, issue links, and recent comments in one call. The focal ticket is highlighted in indigo; subtasks are grouped in a subgraph; issue links use colour-coded arrows (red thick = blocks, cyan dashed = relates to); comments appear in a rose subgraph.

toolsPreview.name: generate_ticket_timeline
toolsPreview.description:
Generate a Mermaid diagram showing the history of a single Jira ticket using its changelog. Two views are available:
- **state**: stateDiagram-v2 showing all status transitions with dates and authors, nodes coloured by status category.
- **timeline** (default): Mermaid timeline grouped by month, showing status changes, assignee changes, priority changes, sprint moves, and resolutions.

toolsPreview.name: get_notion_page_mermaid_diagrams
toolsPreview.description: Extract all Mermaid code blocks from a Notion page. Returns block ID, diagram code, and optional caption for each block.

toolsPreview.name: get_notion_mermaid_diagram_by_block_id
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a single Mermaid diagram block by its block ID. Returns the diagram code and optional caption.

toolsPreview.name: update_notion_mermaid_diagram
toolsPreview.description: Update the Mermaid source code (and optional caption) of an existing mermaid code block by its block ID.

toolsPreview.name: insert_notion_mermaid_diagram
toolsPreview.description: Append a Mermaid diagram as a code block to a Notion page. The block is added at the end of the page content.
